dark.lab_reference_caveat: Cached pre-test dark, acquisition temperature/time not captured in this run.

thermal_settings_comparison.qualification: Archived ntc_t_coeff=3988 reads unused external NTC 0x008A. Internal LD B was not archived. Separate 2026-10-09 debugger reads of internal 0x007F returned 3988 K for all six. Programming/readback now use 0x007F; defaults remain unchanged. Vendor-slope comparison concerns programmed conversion, not measured physical thermistor slope or proven instability cause.

idle_thermistor_constraints.model_basis: Rounded B equivalent of generic FLC -4.4 %/C datasheet slope; not an archived internal coefficient.
assumptions: Common physical temperature of all idle diodes.
Other-five mean is the target-independent reference, normalized to R25=10 kohm and the model B.
Constant-B thermistor conversion; individual controller calibration/conversion errors are folded into equivalent R25.
idle_thermistor_constraints.qualification: Relative model equivalents, not measured physical resistor values or automatic calibration settings. Both parameters are poorly separated by a cold 15-19 C span.
idle_thermistor_constraints.selection: Original initial-idle cutoffs; powered bank, all six reported idle, fresh poll <=20 s, no error, all six readings finite. Fits are duration-weighted contiguous intervals <=20 s.
idle_thermistor_constraints.live_basis_note: All six internal registers read 3988 K today. The archive model retains its explicitly conditional FLC comparison B=3911; B-only ratios are unchanged, and R25 ratios at 3988 follow exp(3988*c).

tec_calibration_trial.disposition: Retain factory 100%; no new TEC setting or LD calibration rename. Measured regulation agrees with the digital target at 100%.
tec_calibration_trial.qualification: Controller temperature readbacks, no independent physical temperature/current reference. Short plateaus, last three samples summarized. TEC current resolution 100 mA and voltage 0.1 V. Controller internals remain unconfirmed.
